sentences.text: Heard Mr. S. Rahman, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. P.S.
Lahkar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam.
This is an application made under Section 438 Cr.P.C., seeking pre-arrest bail by the petitioner,
namely, Moynul Hoque @ Moinul Hoque, apprehending arrest in connection with Gauripur P.S.
Case Page No.# 2/2 No. 314/2023, registered under Section 376/323/34 IPC.
Mr. Rahman, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has appeared before the Investigating Police Officer as per direction of this Court and his statement has already been Moynul Hoque @ Moinul Hoque vs The State Of Assam on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21957131/
1 recorded after he was granted interim protection.

entities.text: Moynul Hoque @ Moinul Hoque vs The State Of Assam
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He has not misused the liberty granted to him;
rather, he co-operate with the investigation of the case.
Therefore, the privilege of pre-arrest bail granted to the petitioner may be made absolute.

Mr. Lahkar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State submits that as the statement of petitioner has already been recorded by the investigating officer and as such, his custodial interrogation may not be required.
I have considered the submission made by the learned counsel for the parties and also perused the case diary.
It appears that the petitioner has not misused the liberty granted to him while availing interim protection.
Considering all, this Court is of the view that the petitioner deserves to be granted the privilege of pre-arrest bail.
That being so, the petitioner is granted the privilege of pre- arrest bail.
Accordingly, the interim protection granted to the petitioner vide order dated 12.10.2023, is made absolute on the same terms and conditions, as reflected.
The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
